summary: Feed s081_single to IDS is degraded due to 8.7% packet loss (214/2458 TCP packets with gaps) exceeding 1% threshold. All other visibility checks (duplicates, encryption, VLANs, one-way, tool overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Upstream capture loss before the IDS - 8.7% of TCP packets show missing data/sequence gaps consistent with SPAN/mirror oversubscription or packet broker ingress buffer drops. Tool overload check is healthy, so loss is not due to 1Gbps IDS port overload but at the SPAN/broker layer.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires both directions and full payload for TCP stream reassembly and signature matching. 8.7% missing segments breaks reassembly, causes missed exploit detection, allows evasion, and reduces detection coverage significantly.

recommended_fix.why: Replace lossy SPAN/mirror with passive TAP (or dedicated broker aggregation with adequate buffering) to provide lossless, line-rate copy. TAP eliminates SPAN buffer overflow drops and ensures IDS receives complete flows for reliable detection.
